title: Lines tab shows the technicians scheduled on a line
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Owner (work-order View) on a desktop viewport, at the location the work order belongs to.
A work order for a new customer with no pinned note and no lead technician, with two lines approved for repair (Line 1 and Line 2), neither with a labor technician.
Technician A has a shift on the Schedule that covers Line 2 only, so A is on Line 2's technician roster without a labor task.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open the work order's Lines tab.
custom_steps_separated.expected: Both lines are listed and no New Line dialog opens.
It shows technician A's full name where it used to say "Unassigned" or "No technicians assigned to this line.", with no badge.
It still says the line has no technician and does not show A's name.
